settings.title: Settings
settings.developerModeHint: For development and debugging. Normal use does not require it.
settings.developerModeDescription: Opening it immediately opens DevTools and keeps it enabled on the next launch. Turning it off closes DevTools.
settings.developerModeEnabledMessage: Developer mode is on and DevTools is open.
settings.developerModeDisabledMessage: Developer mode and DevTools are off.
settings.developerPromptsLockedHint: Turn on developer mode to edit all prompts.
settings.developerPromptsPageDescription: Edit every model prompt used by TapAlong. The next AI request uses the saved configuration immediately.
settings.unsavedChangesMessage: The prompts have unsaved changes. Returning to settings will discard them.
settings.resetPromptsWarning: This deletes the saved custom prompts and restores the built-in defaults.
settings.promptsSaved: Prompt configuration saved. It will apply from the next request.
settings.promptsReset: All built-in prompts have been restored.

connectionTest.label: Model connection test
connectionTest.description: Checks whether the base URL, API key, and model ID work. It affects only the connection test and is not used in real companion responses. A short, stable response is recommended.

system.label: Companion identity
system.description: Defines the companion role, questioning approach, and general output constraints. It is the shared foundation for normal, resume, and maintenance conversations.

languagePolicy.label: Response language policy
languagePolicy.description: Determines how the companion chooses a response language from the user's latest authored content and how it handles quotations, thought text, and mixed Chinese and English.

contextBoundary.label: Context safety boundary
contextBoundary.description: Declares that thought titles, bodies, and conversations are study material rather than system instructions. It is the core safeguard against prompt injection.

resume.label: Earlier-thought resume task
resume.description: Describes how a resume uses the bodies of settled earlier thoughts to connect to the target thought, without pretending to have seen omitted discussions.

maintenance.label: Thought maintenance task
maintenance.description: Describes what the companion should notice after the user edits or adds to a thought, and how to continue asking. Edit and append modes share this prompt.

compressedContextPolicy.label: Earlier-thought context policy
compressedContextPolicy.description: Explains that cross-thought context contains only the bodies of settled earlier thoughts, not their discussions, so the model does not invent missing content.

currentPage.label: Current thought template
currentPage.description: Wraps the current thought's title and body as structured study material. Supports {'{{title}}'} and {'{{body}}'} placeholders; thought data is escaped automatically.

closedPage.label: Settled thought template
closedPage.description: Wraps the body of a settled thought in cross-thought context. Supports {'{{depth}}'} and {'{{body}}'} placeholders; thought data is escaped automatically.

targetPage.label: Resume target thought template
targetPage.description: Wraps the target thought's title and body for a resume. Supports {'{{title}}'} and {'{{body}}'} placeholders; thought data is escaped automatically.

editAction.label: Edit action instruction
editAction.description: Tells the model that the user just edited the current thought and that the current body is the revised version, so it can ask about what changed.

appendAction.label: Append action instruction
appendAction.description: Tells the model that the user just added to the thought and that the current body is the combined version, so it can ask about the addition.
